gbm_population_evidence.quote: A Phase 1 Trial of D2C7-IT in Combination With Atezolizumab in Recurrent WHO Grade IV Malignant Glioma
Patients must have a recurrent supratentorial WHO grade IV malignant glioma based on imaging studies

candidate_evidence.quote: This is a phase 1 study of atezolizumab in combination with D2C7-IT, a dual-specific monoclonal antibody (mAB) with a high affinity for both EGFRwt- and EGFRvIII-expressing cells

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Patients must have a recurrent supratentorial WHO grade IV malignant glioma based on imaging studies

role_evidence.quote: Single D2C7-IT convection-enhanced delivery (CED) infusion (6920 ng/mL) plus atezolizumab (1200 mg) intravenous (IV) infusions every three weeks for up to two years

agents.drug_class_hint: dual-specific anti-EGFRwt/EGFRvIII monoclonal antibody immunotoxin, intratumoral convection-enhanced delivery

role_evidence.quote: This is a phase 1 study of atezolizumab in combination with D2C7-IT

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: programmed cell death ligand 1 (PD-L1) blocking antibody

coder_notes: Conditions field says only Malignant Glioma; glioblastoma appears only in keywords. Coded gbm_only/historical under D27C because the title and inclusion criteria require WHO grade IV malignant glioma with no IDH requirement. The two registered D2C7-IT arms differ only by dose. EGFR/EGFRvIII is the antibody's target but is not an entry requirement or a planned biomarker endpoint, so no biomarker row. MGMT status is mentioned only in an exclusion criterion about prior chemotherapy.
